From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agentic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation.

DecoyCount: Evaluating Visual-Reasoning Misalignment in Counting. DecoyCount: Evaluating Visual-Reasoning Misalignment in Counting Visual counting benchmarks report whether vision-language models produce the correct number, but not whether errors arise from perception or reasoning.
